note: Realistic animal models (Dave 6 Nov 2026: aim for photorealism; design/realistic_animals_plan.md, src/client/animal_view.gd _make_model). A species row here whose scene exists is drawn from that rigged, animated scene instead of the code-built body; no row or a missing file keeps the code body. Row: scene (res:// path of a .glb/.fbx/.tscn), scale, yaw_deg (turn so the animal faces -Z), walk_mps and run_mps (ground speeds the walk and run clips were made at), stride_m (metres per footstep), clips {state number or 'walk'/'run': clip name}; states 0 graze, 1 hop, 2 flee, 3 alert, 10 warn, 11 charge, 12 recover. Example: "bear": {"scene": "res://assets/animals/bear/bear.glb", "scale": 1.0, "yaw_deg": 180, "walk_mps": 1.3, "run_mps": 9.0, "stride_m": 1.1, "clips": {"0": "Eat", "3": "Idle", "10": "Roar", "11": "Run", "12": "Idle", "walk": "Walk", "run": "Run"}}. clip_prefix (optional) is put before every clip name; without it a clip is found by its name after the armature ('Armature|Idle' answers 'Idle'). The model files are bought (WildMesh 3D Ultimate 3D Animal Pack, Dave 6 Nov 2026) and are NOT in git (/assets/animals/ is ignored): copy them from the pack into assets/animals/<kind>/ on a build machine. length_m: the model is scaled so its longest side is this long (any file units). materials: [{match, albedo} or {match, hide: true}] colour textures set in code, first matching entry per surface (match '' = the rest). length_m values: design/wildmesh_scale_table.md (real adult length, nose to tail tip). Species added 7 Nov (deer, moose, boar, wolf, fox, rabbit): yaw, clip speeds and material matches are first guesses from the bear; the shot runner --shot-animals row checks them.

bear.note: WildMesh BrownBear (Realistic Animals/BrownBear/SK_Bear.fbx, textures in its Textures folder): 7508 triangles, 35 bones, 81 clips; faces +Z, so yaw 180. Alert stands up on its hind legs; warn is the angry breathing stance; charge sprints.

goblin.note: Goblins (Dave 7 Nov 2026, docs/GOBLINS.md). Sized by mesh height: height_m plus a bell-shaped roll of up to height_variation_m, per animal id. variants are laid over this row, one per goblin by id: Skritch Ragtooth and Rukz the Scavenger, whose clip names differ. The .glb files are committed (made by Dave in Meshy, not the bought pack). Facing (yaw_deg 180, as the bear) is to be checked on the PC.

deer.note: WildMesh Deer (Realistic Animals/Deer/SK_Deer.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 113 clips. Alert stands breathing, head up.

moose.note: WildMesh Moose (Realistic Animals/Moose/SK_Moose.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 99 clips. Body texture is 4096: set its import size limit to 2048 (art budget).

boar.note: WildMesh WildBoar (Realistic Animals/WildBoar/SK_WildBoar.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 84 clips. Warn barks.

wolf.note: WildMesh Wolf (Realistic Animals/Wolf/SK_Wolf.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 70 clips.

fox.note: WildMesh Fox (Realistic Animals/Fox/SK_Fox.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 51 clips. T_Fox_Fur is the small fur-card texture.

rabbit.note: WildMesh Rabbit (Realistic Animals/Rabbit/SK_Rabbit.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 32 clips.

horse.note: WildMesh Horse (Realistic Animals/Horse/SK_Horse.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 54 clips, 1094 bones (heavy). Wild horses: the saddle is hidden (hide entry).

donkey.note: WildMesh Donkey_1 (Realistic Animals/Donkey_1/SK_Donkey.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 54 clips, 185 MB: the same clip set as the horse is assumed (same count, same saddles); a 'no clip' log line says otherwise. The light Donkey folder (4.6 MB, 12 clips) is the fallback if this one is too heavy. Saddle hidden.

lynx.note: WildMesh Lynx (Realistic Animals/Lynx/SK_Lynx.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 95 clips; units are metres. Fur cards are the M_lynx_cards surface.

black_bear.note: WildMesh BlackBear (Realistic Animals/BlackBear/SK_BlackBear.fbx). 136 clips; units are centimetres (rescaled by length_m).

elk.note: WildMesh Elk (Realistic Animals/Elk/SK_Elk.fbx). 58 clips; antler surface is called Chifre. Body texture may be 4096: set its import size limit to 2048 like the moose.

bighorn.note: WildMesh Bighorn Sheep (Realistic Animals/BighornSheep/SK_BighornSheep.fbx). 114 clips; units are centimetres.

mountain_goat.note: WildMesh Mountain Goat (Realistic Animals/MountainGoat/SK_MountainGoat.fbx). 116 clips; units are centimetres. Horn surface is called MountainGoat_Antle.

beaver.note: WildMesh Beaver (Realistic Animals/Beaver/SK_Beaver.fbx). 20 clips; units are centimetres. No graze clip: Idle_2 stands in.
